objective: Add non-terminal Quest v2 soft targets while preserving hard-deadline expiry, rewards, the Neon ledger owner, mutation permission gates and backward compatibility.

roles_before.artifact: Hard deadline automation and EXPIRED semantics.
No hard deadline means no automatic expiry.
Verified completion exclusively controls progression rewards.
Neon system_events is the mutable derived-state owner.
system_apply_action validates and idempotently applies writes.
Base SHA is the pre-change rollback point.

role_dispositions.destination: Existing hard deadline engine remains unchanged.
Soft targets never auto-terminalize a quest.
Soft-target events cannot award or remove XP or coins.
Soft-target state is additive ledger state only.
Add quest.soft_target.set while delegating existing actions unchanged.
PWA additionally renders target timing and lateness.
Base SHA remains complete rollback provenance.

capability_probes.assertion: Hard deadlines still expire once server-side.
Passing a soft target cannot create FAILED, EXPIRED or reward events.
Quests without soft targets remain unchanged.
Profile, skills, attributes, achievements, shop, notifications, strategy context and resolution remain unchanged.
